skills.name: Bajiquan
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Jeweled Sword Zelretch
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Second Magic Experiment
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to all enemies. Then, consumes #2[i] "Gem Energy" to additionally deal Quantum DMG equal to #3[i]% of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one random enemy target. This repeats until "Gem Energy" is less than #2[i] or there are no enemy targets with current HP greater than 0. Can repeat up to #6[i] cycle(s). When used, if the current Skill Points are greater than #4[i], consumes Skill Points down to #4[i], and for each Point consumed, immediately gains #5[i] "Gem Energy."

skills.name: An Gal Ta Ki Gal Šè
skills.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to one designated enemy, and Quantum DMG equal to #2[i]% of Rin Tohsaka's ATK to other enemy targets. When used, recovers #4[i] Skill Point(s) for allies, and increases the DMG taken by all enemies by #5[i]%, lasting for #6[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Gem Magecraft
skills.desc: When entering combat, gains #1[i] "Gem Energy." When an ally target consumes or recovers Skill Points, increases their CRIT DMG by #3[i]% for #2[i] turn(s). For every 1 Skill Point consumed or recovered, Rin Tohsaka gains 1 "Gem Energy." If Rin Tohsaka holds #5[i] or more "Gem Energy," or if the current Skill Points are #4[i] or more, her Skill is enhanced to "Second Magic Experiment."

skills.name: Freeform Tohsaka Style
skills.desc: After Archer uses his Skill "Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword" to attack, if Skill Points are #3[i] or fewer or if "Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword" has been actively used 5 times during the current "Circuit Connection" state, and the Joint Follow-Up ATK from "Freeform Tohsaka Style" has not been triggered, Rin Tohsaka and Archer will launch Joint Follow-Up ATK on all enemies, dealing Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Rin Tohsaka's ATK and #4[i]% of Archer's ATK respectively, and recovering #2[i] Skill Point(s) for allies. This Joint Follow-Up ATK can only trigger once. The trigger count resets when Rin Tohsaka's turn ends.

skills.name: Conversion Charge
skills.desc: After using Technique, gains #1[i] "Gem Energy" at the start of the next battle.

passives.name: Elegant Conduct
passives.desc: While Rin Tohsaka is on the field, additionally increases the upper limit of Skill Points by 2. When entering combat, Rin Tohsaka's ATK increases by 150%, and Quantum RES PEN increases by 15%. If Archer is in the team, Archer also gains this effect.

passives.name: Ladylike Poise
passives.desc: When entering combat or after using Enhanced Skill, increases Rin Tohsaka's SPD by 20%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

passives.name: Inbound Prosperity
passives.desc: When Rin Tohsaka uses Ultimate, gains 12 "Gem Energy."
